Since 2009, Bitcoin is growing faster than any other currency on this planet. And many people have earned millions with it. However, the biggest growth is yet to come. Bitcoin and other digital currencies are by far the most successful investment segment of the past decade and everyone is able to participate. By the time this video is made, the value of Bitcoin is at around US$2,300. But the more people who learn about the advantages of bitcoin and use the benefit for daily payments the harder growth is going to be in the future. If you combine the thousands of new people which start bitcoin each day and all the companies which accept bitcoin as a kind of payment with the fact that only a limited amount of Bitcoin is avaliable, then you will get it that the reduced supply and the rapidly growing demand will have the value of Bitcoin increase even more. It is really almost impossible to recognize why the most successful and richest entrepreneurs or investors put so much of big part in Bitcoin take over their portfolio. However, most people do not understand that everyone could actually participate in that and that they didn't already own millions to participate in this 1,000 chance of their lifetime. In fact, if you possess Bitcoins worth only $100, and Bitcoin goes up to one million, If you have now only 100 dolla in Bitcoins, your Bitcoin is worth 43.000 Dollars... The first one is, you open up a so called e-wallet, or bitcoin account in one of the many sellers at no cost. You will buy bitcoin there and just leave it there. Similar to a stock, you will access the expected value increase. The second strategy is to invest over the bitclub in bitcoin mining and increase your bitcoins, by joining the mining-ab participating in high-performance computers that aim to mine bitcoins. So you don't have to worry about physical hardware, because our experts will take care of this.
